methodology.name: CMMC Level 2 Scoring Methodology
methodology.requirements: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 (110 requirements), assessed with NIST SP 800-171A (June 2018)

notChecked: Whether each requirement is really MET. The score is recomputed from the results you entered; SpreadRun does not see your systems, evidence or SSP.

sources.cfr170.24: 32 CFR 170.24, CMMC Scoring Methodology (Level 2 point values, partial credit, SSP, N/A)
sources.cfr170.21: 32 CFR 170.21, Plan of Action and Milestones requirements (0.8 threshold, eligible requirements, 180-day closeout)
sources.cfr170.16: 32 CFR 170.16, CMMC Level 2 self-assessment (SPRS contents, three-year cycle, affirmation)
sources.cfr170.4: 32 CFR 170.4, Definitions (MET, NOT MET, N/A, CMMC Status Date, Affirming Official)
sources.nist800-171: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2, the 110 CMMC Level 2 security requirements
sources.nist800-171a: NIST SP 800-171A (June 2018), assessment objectives (a requirement is MET only when all its applicable objectives are met)
sources.dla-cage: Defense Logistics Agency: the CAGE code is five characters

report.scope: A verified score is arithmetic from the results you entered, checked against the published CMMC scoring methodology. It is not a CMMC certification or assessment, not legal or compliance advice, and a PASS does not mean your company meets NIST SP 800-171 or that DoD will accept the score.
